name: BANK-04 prepare paid history and missing recipient

tests.name: Deposit funds through authenticated bank workflow
Create daily recurring order to existing recipient

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Schedule the bank handler at first occurrence

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank04_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Advance actual bank scheduler to pay first occurrence
First occurrence paid with two ledger legs and balances conserved

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bank_order_occurrences WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id} AND outcome='paid' AND amount=10) AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=2 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||@{bank04_order_id}||'-%') AND (SELECT balance=40 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank04_payer_qa') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE) AND (SELECT balance=10 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank04_recipient_qa') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Simulate recipient later ceasing to exist

data.sql: UPDATE bank_orders SET to_id=99999999 WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id};

UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN (SELECT next_run_at FROM bank_orders WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id}) ELSE next_due_at END;
